title: AstroKitManifestV4
description: AstroKit kit.json manifest schema, version 4. Supersedes v3. Adds outputs.artifacts[] as closed objects {path: string, tags?: [email_attachment]} with at-most-one email_attachment enforced post-parse in validate_manifest.py. Top-level object is open (additionalProperties not constrained). Inner artifact objects are closed (additionalProperties: false). v3 retained through the next release cycle — see schemas/kit-manifest.v3.schema.json.

aptToolEntry.title: AptToolEntry
aptToolEntry.description: A tool installed from the system APT package manager (Debian/Ubuntu). Uses the Debian package-name regex to reject uppercase letters, shell metacharacters, and malformed names.

source.description: Discriminator field identifying this entry as an APT-sourced package.

name.description: Debian package name. Must match Debian Policy §5.6.7 regex: lowercase alphanumeric, plus, hyphen, dot only. Minimum two characters. Rejects uppercase, shell metacharacters, and lookalike Unicode.

version.description: Optional APT package version string (e.g. 1:2.38.1-5). APT version syntax is complex (epoch, upstream, revision); this schema accepts any non-empty string. Exact-pin enforcement is in the Phase 33 validator.

verify.description: Optional POSIX shell one-liner Astro runs post-install to confirm the tool is functional. Exit code 0 = healthy. Semantic meaning specified in Astro installer spec (Phase 37).

pipToolEntry.title: PipToolEntry
pipToolEntry.description: A Python package installed via pip. Uses PEP 503 normalized name regex and an exact-pin version regex to reject semver ranges and wildcards.

source.description: Discriminator field identifying this entry as a pip-sourced Python package.

name.description: Python package name in PEP 503 normalized form: lowercase, hyphens only, no consecutive hyphens. Rejects uppercase, underscores, dots, and lookalike chars. Single-char names allowed (e.g. 'a').

version.description: Exact-pin pip version string (e.g. 1.45.0, 2.0.0a1, 1.0.0.post1). Rejects semver ranges (>=1.0), caret (^1.0), wildcards (*), and meta tokens (latest). Per D-09.

verify.description: Optional POSIX shell one-liner Astro runs post-install to confirm the tool is functional. Exit code 0 = healthy. Semantic meaning specified in Astro installer spec (Phase 37).

npmToolEntry.title: NpmToolEntry
npmToolEntry.description: A Node.js package installed via npm. Accepts scoped names (@scope/pkg). Enforces exact semver version pinning; rejects ranges and operators.

source.description: Discriminator field identifying this entry as an npm-sourced Node.js package.

name.description: npm package name. Non-empty string; accepts scoped packages (e.g. @scope/pkg) and standard names. npm naming rules beyond non-empty are enforced by the registry, not this schema.

version.description: Exact semver version string (e.g. 3.2.1, 1.0.0-beta.1, 2.0.0+build.1). Rejects caret (^), tilde (~), >=, <=, *, latest, and range expressions. Per D-09.

global.description: Whether to install the package globally (npm install -g). Defaults to false if omitted.

verify.description: Optional POSIX shell one-liner Astro runs post-install to confirm the tool is functional. Exit code 0 = healthy. Semantic meaning specified in Astro installer spec (Phase 37).

urlToolEntry.title: UrlToolEntry
urlToolEntry.description: A tool downloaded from an HTTPS URL. Requires sha256 integrity hash and filename. URL must use HTTPS to prevent MITM attacks. sha256 must be a full 64-character lowercase hex digest.

source.description: Discriminator field identifying this entry as a URL-downloaded tool.

url.description: HTTPS URL to download the tool from. Must start with https:// to prevent MITM attacks (T-32-02). HTTP URLs fail validation.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the downloaded file, lowercase, exactly 64 characters. Astro's installer verifies the download against this value. Empty string and partial hex digests are rejected (T-32-01).

filename.description: Local filename to save the downloaded file as. Used by Astro's installer when writing to disk.

executable.description: Whether the downloaded file should be made executable (chmod +x). Defaults to false.

verify.description: Optional POSIX shell one-liner Astro runs post-install to confirm the tool is functional. Exit code 0 = healthy. Semantic meaning specified in Astro installer spec (Phase 37).

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. Must be exactly 4 for this schema. Use kit-manifest.v3.schema.json for v3 kits.

requires.description: Optional declaration of host preconditions (per D-01). Three sibling fields: tools[] (external binaries Astro installs per source), runtime[] (free-form runtime VM identifiers like python3, bash, node), astro (semver range of Astro versions this kit targets). All three siblings are optional (per D-02).

tools.description: Array of tool-entry objects. Each entry is discriminated on its source field via oneOf over four subschemas in $defs.

runtime.description: Array of runtime VM identifiers the kit's scripts execute under (e.g. python3, bash, node). Free strings per D-03 — no enum, accommodates new runtimes without schema bump.

astro.description: Semver range string declaring which Astro versions this kit targets (e.g. >=0.3.0). Per D-04 enforced by regex; accepts >=, <=, =, range expressions; rejects bare partial versions like 0.3 and meta tokens like latest.

outputs.description: Optional. Describes deliverables this kit produces for end users. When present, artifacts[] items must be objects with a path field and an optional tags field closed to the email_attachment value.

artifacts.description: Ordered list of output artifact objects. Each item is a closed object with required path and optional tags. The email_attachment tag marks the single artifact Astro attaches to email replies. At most one artifact per kit may carry this tag — enforced post-parse by validate_manifest.py (not expressible in JSON Schema without awkward gymnastics).

path.description: Relative path to the output file within the kit's runtime output directory.

tags.description: Optional semantic tags. Closed to email_attachment in v4. At most one artifact per kit may carry this tag.
